verdict.rationale: Twenty documents connecting Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 so that calendar events automatically appear on relevant CRM records, which delivers the core of calendar sync onto record timelines. The only explicit record-type linking in the evidence is for emails, which go to Company and People records. Nothing confirms that meetings land on deal (opportunity) timelines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of calendar events on deal/opportunity timelines, detail on calendar-specific matching and sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines

citations.quote: Emails and calendar events automatically appear on the relevant CRM records.
Emails are automatically linked to the matching Company and People records
